name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio: Klaus-Dieter Richter's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent near the Nürburgring. He began his career as a junior mechanic, working his way up through the ranks with relentless dedication and a keen eye for detail. After several years honing his skills in various racing series, he transitioned into race engineering, finding his niche in optimizing car performance and driver feedback. He is known for his methodical approach, adapting seamlessly to new regulations and technologies, and his unwavering loyalty to his team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is of average height with a lean build and a serious demeanor etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of German coffee before every race.
